kitDescription: Diesel (Treasure) is a Wind machine-gun Defender whose Burst II strikes up to five enemies with the highest attack for about 300% of her own attack, doubles her maximum HP for 10 seconds without healing her, and taunts all enemies for 10 seconds. Her first skill raises her own DEF for 10 seconds whenever the team enters Full Burst, heals her when she is hit while her taunt is active, and raises her buff stack cap after landing 150 normal attacks while taunting. Her second skill adds a Strawberry Candy stack every 70 normal attacks, each stack enlarging her magazine by 56.7% for 10 seconds, up to ten stacks. When she reaches ten stacks they are consumed and the whole team instantly reloads 86.62% of their magazine and gains +30% Pierce Damage for 10 seconds. In practice she is a tank whose personal damage is her machine-gun fire, with her team value coming from the magazine-refill and Pierce support.

verdictRationale: All eight kit lines are FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED_GAP and the three independent derivations converge: the S2b spec, the S5 blind test (20/20 runnable assertions green; the 4 skips are the blind author's own GAP/⚑ lines), and the S6 blind override (line-for-line identical on all five load-bearing blocks). No REAL-GOTCHA exists: the trigger identities (fullBurstEnter vs burstCast on S1; burstCast pre-FB on the nuke), the per-stack 56.7 reading, the instantReload-not-reloadSpeed encoding, the pierce-bucket confinement, the single-hit burst collapse, and the no-heal Max-HP grant are each pinned by a discriminating assertion that fails under its named nearest-wrong model, and every inertness claim is proven by byte-identical counterfactual removal rather than asserted. The two blind-vs-driver divergences are null: crit:true on the nuke equals the engine's default crit-on burst behavior, and the Attract targetStatus-vs-unmodeled split is inert placement both sides document. The real residual risk is shared and flagged, not hidden: the L5 hitCount:700 proxy, the missing stack-reset sawtooth, the stack-refresh ambiguity (a blind-only ⚑ worth adopting verbatim into the driver's caveats), and the MG cadence datamine (rate_of_fire 60→4200, reloadFrames 151) all rest on unmeasured ground — the owner should spot-check a Diesel focus video for rounds/min, whether Strawberry Candy visibly reaches 10 simultaneous stacks, and whether new stacks refresh old ones, since those gate whether the team-reload cadence is over- or under-credited. The driver's adaptation of the blind test (custom B1/B2/B3 fixture per the blind author's own header instruction, reader-bug fixes, ±2→15% cadence tolerance for MG wind-up) is transparently documented and preserves every discriminating assertion — the 15% band still excludes the 100-hit, 150-hit, and per-shot counterfactuals. Nothing must change for GO; adopting the blind's stack-refresh ⚑ caveat is a nice-to-have documentation improvement.
